adjudication.rationale: The diff shows both new controller specs only assert inheritance (spec/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller_spec.rb and embedding_controller_spec.rb). They do not exercise create/update/destroy/show endpoints. That’s significant because the new controllers contain nontrivial/fragile behavior that could 500 without being caught (e.g., Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#update/#destroy use `.where(...).first` and then call `save_host(host)` / `host.destroy` without nil checks; save_host dereferences `params[:embeddable_host][:host]` and `[:category_id]` and will raise if params are missing). Admin::EmbeddingController#update also appears to be a no-op (just re-renders the serializer). The finding is therefore a concrete, diff-grounded test coverage gap rather than a purely stylistic request.
